prompt: The notes/ directory holds three hundred meeting notes. Over the course of the meetings the team agreed on a release name several times, and all but one of those names were later withdrawn in other meetings after a trademark check. Find the one name that was agreed on and never withdrawn, and write just that name to answer.txt.
setup:
mkdir -p notes; i=1; while [ "$i" -le 300 ]; do f=$(printf 'notes/meeting-%03d.txt' "$i"); printf 'Meeting %s

' "$i" > "$f"; j=1; while [ "$j" -le 24 ]; do printf 'Item %s.%s: discussed the release schedule, the on-call rotation and the open incidents; no decision on naming.
' "$i" "$j" >> "$f"; j=$((j + 1)); done; i=$((i + 1)); done; n=1; for name in ALDER BASALT CEDAR DUNE EMBER FJORD GARNET HARBOR INLET JUNIPER KESTREL LARCH MARROW NIMBUS ORCHID PEBBLE QUARRY RIDGE SABLE THICKET UMBER VELVET WILLOW XENON YARROW ZEPHYR ANVIL BRAMBLE COBALT DELTA ELM FLINT GROVE HOLLOW IRIS JASPER KELP LINDEN MEADOW NORTH; do p=$((3 + 7 * (n - 1))); printf 'Item %s.25: after a long discussion the team agreed to ship the release under the name %s.
' "$p" "$name" >> "$(printf 'notes/meeting-%03d.txt' "$p")"; if [ "$name" != KESTREL ]; then r=$((300 - 5 * (n - 1))); case $((n % 3)) in 0) printf 'Item %s.26: legal reported back: %s was dropped after the trademark check, so the release will not ship under that name.
' "$r" "$name" >> "$(printf 'notes/meeting-%03d.txt' "$r")";; 1) printf 'Item %s.26: the name %s did not clear the trademark check and is withdrawn; a new name is needed.
' "$r" "$name" >> "$(printf 'notes/meeting-%03d.txt' "$r")";; 2) printf 'Item %s.26: %s is out: the trademark check failed, so the release will not ship as %s.
' "$r" "$name" "$name" >> "$(printf 'notes/meeting-%03d.txt' "$r")";; esac; fi; n=$((n + 1)); done; i=1; while [ "$i" -le 300 ]; do printf 'Action: circulate the release checklist before the next meeting.
' >> "$(printf 'notes/meeting-%03d.txt' "$i")"; i=$((i + 1)); done; { cat "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true; } | wc -l | tr -d ' ' > .runs-before
check: test "$(tr -d ' \n' < answer.txt | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')" = KESTREL && if [ -n "$ARNES_SESSION_ID" ]; then grep "\"parentSessionId\":\"$ARNES_SESSION_ID\"" "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" | grep -q '"agent":"explore"'; else tail -n "+$(( $(cat .runs-before) + 1 ))" "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" | grep -q '"agent":"explore"'; fi
